log.msg: lesson: repeated ux-doc/decisions.md own documented trap - an inline --gap on a words-comparison wrapper INHERITS into the card below it, so the default panel silently wore the compact 0.5em gap (probed: formGap 8px on both). Fix: no inline --gap on the caption wrapper, default 1em is correct.

assign.now: layout: five questions answered before the first factory call

log.msg: layout Q1 container: neither main (not prose) nor bleed alone (not a dashboard) - the card is .measure, the caller supplies the wash ground it centers against
layout Q2 size: 400 = wash band full width, card at its own cap; 1280/1920/3440 = card stays ~26em, band fills the rest - never full width, never a fixed px
layout Q3 own layout: flex v gap throughout - a field is ui/field's own label-wraps-input, tightened to --gap 0.4em; fields between themselves stay the default 1em
layout Q4 containers: two on the page - the exhibit band (render+source) and the words-proof band; magic-auth is its own Doc tab, not a region
layout Q5 preview: login screen at zoom-50 on a wash - a picture, not a live card

log.msg: registered ux-auth- in css-scopes.txt, following the per-module convention ux-tree-/ux-wizard- already on disk from sibling tasks today (not a shared ux- tier prefix like ui-)

lesson: repeated ux/doc/decisions.md's own documented trap - an inline --gap on the words-band caption wrapper INHERITS into the Auth card below it, so the default panel silently wore the compact 0.5em gap. Probed with getComputedStyle before trusting the screenshot: formGap was 8px on BOTH panels. Fix: no inline --gap on the wrapper, the default 1em is correct. Caught by measuring, not by looking - same lesson the words page itself records.

assign.now: verification: screenshots 360/768/1280/3440, interaction proof, md-error sweep

log.msg: verified: overflow_x 0 at 360/768/1280/3440; no console errors beyond the known LiveReload WebSocket noise; no .md-error on overview/magic-auth/doc/files tabs

interaction proof (headless): Create account switches view live; submit empty shows :user-invalid red borders + ui/alert 'Please fill out this field.' with no JS-written message text; valid submit shows the accent confirmation 'Signed in.'; magic-auth's card has exactly one input (email) - password_field() returning nothing renders nothing

verdict: the named-extension pattern holds for a workflow, not just a component. MagicAuth extends Auth is 14 lines overriding 4 seams (login_title, login_cta, password_field, confirmations) with signup/reset/switching/validation/social row all untouched. The seam that made it cheap already existed before the extension did: login() calls this.password_field() instead of building the field inline - a method that composes N things needs N seams, not one seam for the whole method. Full writeup: ux/Auth/doc/decisions.md
note: several earlier log timestamps this session were typed estimates rather than read from the clock, drifting ~15-25min ahead of it - lesson for new-task's own warning about this trap
